content:
Rumors about the next-generation Apple TV 4K have been circulating, with reports suggesting the new device will feature a more modern chip to support Apple Intelligence. However, a new round of leaks discovered by Aaron Perris indicates that the chip's performance in this device will be even more powerful than expected.

The leaked code shows that the upcoming Apple TV 4K will be equipped with an A19 or A19 Pro chip.

We've been waiting for a new Apple TV 4K for quite a while now—longer than any period in this product's history.

There were originally rumors that the new model would launch in 2025, with evidence pointing to an A17 Pro chip. That chip is currently the minimum requirement to support Apple Intelligence, so it makes perfect sense, and it's clearly an upgrade over the existing A15 Bionic.

But according to Aaron Perris, the new Apple TV 4K will feature a better chip than expected. He wrote:

We found data on Apple's upcoming Apple TV model, the AppleTV18,1.

razmsu pinned comment

My only wish is that the remote can make sounds so I can find it when I lose it. That's all. Please.

The "18,1" identifier is similar to last year's iPhone 17 series. Some iPhone 17 models use the A19 chip, while the iPhone Air and 17 Pro models use the A19 Pro.

Both chips would bring significant upgrades to the Apple TV. But I think it's more likely to use the A19 Pro, since it's the only one that supports the most advanced Siri AI features.

Siri AI is expected to be one of the headline features of the new Apple TV 4K. Given how long it's been since the last hardware update, hopefully Apple won't miss out on some AI features right after the new device launches.

Are you planning to buy the new Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
